none: PAS NLM-080824: Roman Coin: Denarius indeterminate
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin fragment. Denarius of an indeterminate Early Roman ruler, possibly clean-shaven and possibly with retrograde legend. Obverse description: Head right. Obverse inscription: [--]DIVI[--] (read from outer edge of flan). Reverse description: Appears to show a robed figure behind a large beast, possibly a priest driving a plough team left; other combinations might be entertained. Suggested…
